Claire: Observed duplicate side-effects in onboarding sample when a long /generate gets 429 during token rotate. Node quickstart missing idempotency header; Retry-After was 0.7 and client retried immediately (rounded to 0).

Tom: Oof. SDK parity bug: Node rounded Retry-After to int. Go and Python parse float.

Eli: Quick mitigations: (1) SDKs parse Retry-After as float, clamp min to 100ms, (2) default full-jitter backoff, (3) auto-add X-Redwood-Idempotency-Key per logical op for HTTP flows, opt-out flag.

Tom: Backoff example (full jitter):
```js
function backoff(attempt, base=200) {
  const cap=20000; const raw=Math.min(cap, base*2**attempt);
  return Math.floor(Math.random()*raw);
}
```

Claire: For streaming/partial outputs propose an opt-in resume token header: X-Redwood-Resume-Shim on start, server returns X-Redwood-Resume-Token; retries include token to resume instead of replay.

qa-bot: Reproduced on staging. Duplicate rate ~0.9% without idempotency, ~0% with idempotency. Filed RD-10011 for parity + resume-token work.

DevX Bot: Docs draft: https://redwood.dev/docs/sdk/retries (section: fractional Retry-After, idempotency, resume token).

Claire: I'll update quickstart + open Node SDK PR to parse floats and add idempotency. Eli please take Go/Python parity tests.
